descriptions.job-0j80yhh:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. This is an opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Technical Account Managers work cross-functionally to support Stripe’s largest and most complex users. Through trusted relationships, we offer customized, strategic consultation and proactively identify opportunities to help businesses deliver more value to their customers, optimize their technical operations, and accelerate global growth with Stripe.

What you’ll do

Strategically support Stripe’s largest and most complex users.

Responsibilities

  • Provide a Gold Standard Experience to key stakeholders at your assigned accounts.
  • Work with the broader Operations team to share current-state context, resources, and knowledge that support a Gold Standard Experience across teams that interact directly with users through support channels, external documentation, product feedback, and product development.
  • Build long-term user relationships that increase loyalty to Stripe and its products.
  • Work cross-functionally, both internally and within users’ organizations, to provide and implement operational solutions across areas including fraud and disputes, declines, product adoption, and global expansion.
  • Partner with Account Management and other user-facing teams as part of a broader effort to support Stripe users.
  • Lead user-facing meetings in person and by video.
  • Contribute to the continued design of this support offering.
  • Create user-facing content that provides long-term solutions.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements for the role. If you meet these requirements, we encourage you to apply. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of enterprise-level, client-facing experience.
  • Strong product sense and enthusiasm for solving difficult user-related problems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to lead complex integration conversations in a highly consultative and proactive manner.
  • Familiarity with application programming interfaces (APIs) and the ability to explain API concepts to Stripe’s largest and most technical customers.
  • Familiarity with Structured Query Language (SQL) and comfort building basic queries and modifying more complex ones.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills and comfort working with technical teams.
  • Strong client relationship management skills, including the ability to lead business and technical conversations with stakeholders at multiple levels of an organization.
  • Bachelor's degree is required.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in the payments industry
  • An operations-focused mindset, with the ability to identify and reduce process friction while building scalable processes.
  • Experience managing small- to medium-scale projects.
  • Strong organizational skills and a self-starting approach.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As Associate General Counsel, you'll join Coinbase's Privacy Legal team reporting to the Managing General Counsel. You'll serve as a senior legal advisor on privacy and data protection across the company's global operations. This role sits at the intersection of product development, regulatory strategy, and data governance, advising teams on how to build privacy-forward products while navigating a rapidly evolving regulatory landscape. You'll partner with Privacy Operations, Product Counsel, Security, and Engineering to shape Coinbase's privacy program, translate complex global requirements into actionable guidance, and represent the company with regulators and government agencies in one of its most important markets.

What you'll do

  • Own the development, implementation, and scaling of Coinbase's global privacy program in partnership with Privacy Operations, including policy drafting, data protection agreements, and transparency reports
  • Lead cross-functional privacy initiatives spanning data governance, data protection tooling, and data subject rights processes in collaboration with CX, Engineering, and international teams
  • Partner with Product and Commercial Counsel to embed privacy-by-design principles into the product development and launch lifecycle, translating regulatory requirements into clear, actionable product guidance
  • Drive Coinbase's response to privacy incidents, regulatory inquiries, and law enforcement demands in coordination with Security and Trust & Risk
  • Shape Coinbase's external privacy narrative and engage directly with government agencies, privacy regulators, and data protection authorities across EMEA and globally

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 8+ years as a practicing attorney with 5+ years of substantive privacy experience, including in-house experience at technology or financial services companies
  • JD or international equivalent, with qualification as a lawyer in the UK, Ireland, or an EU jurisdiction
  • Deep expertise in EU and international privacy and data protection law (GDPR, PIPEDA, LGPD, CCPA/CPRA, state data breach notification laws) with demonstrated ability to map global requirements to business practices and compliance controls
  • Proven track record leading complex, cross-functional privacy programs requiring coordination across Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, and Operations
  • Experience drafting and negotiating privacy policies, data protection agreements, and vendor information security terms, and responding to regulatory inquiries from data protection and consumer protection authorities
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

descriptions.job-1dysw0l:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Web Presence and Platform is organized into two pillars, each of which is grouped into pods that focus on the central tenets of Stripe's public mission. The Presence pillar creates industry-leading designs for Stripe's front door surfaces, educating customers about the power of our platform, sharing Stripe's ideas and expertise with the public, and driving adoption. The Platform pillar builds the internal machinery that powers these surfaces, and is responsible for making our websites fast, stable, and easy to update.

Together we design and build stripe.com and other sites that amount to what is, for many, their first impression of Stripe. As such, WPP offers exciting opportunities to have a major impact on Stripe's success. We want to make every pixel count, we want it to be enthralling, and we want to help other Stripes seamlessly benefit from our systematic work.

What you’ll do

As a Design Engineer you will concept, prototype, and build new experiences for our web presence. You'll bring your creativity and expertise to the full range of the Stripe brand, across evergreen pages as well as time-based campaigns. You'll both utilize and contribute to our libraries and design systems, and, when appropriate, work outside established systems to create new digital moments. You'll constantly have in-browser performance in mind, and create abstractions that other designers and engineers consume and build upon.

All Design Engineers in WPP have a shared commitment to user experience and craft, but each pod has subtly different focus areas. The Collective pod leverages design, animation, and interaction to drive awareness, educate prospective users, and share Stripe's expertise across public surfaces such as Stripe.com, Link, and others. The Expansion pod brings the same creativity and executional rigor to attracting new prospects and driving conversion, focusing on user journeys, interactive and highly polished tools for users, and building targeted experiences for our global users.

As a Design Engineer on the Collective pod, you will help us continue to drive Stripe.com forward, bringing new experiences to life or refining existing content to inform prospective users about the company and its offerings. You will partner closely with designers, other engineers, and partners to execute and evolve the site, bringing technical craft and creativity to the expansive scope of Stripe's web presence.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with our team's designers and partners to both create new experiences for and maintain Stripe.com
  • Work closely with other design engineers, pairing, mentoring, and continually building a culture of excellence
  • Prototype and implement web animations and interaction-heavy product launch materials
  • Build beautiful, best-in-class end-user experiences to solve complex problems
  • Utilize, maintain, and extend our design systems
  • Integrate our web platform with self-serve authoring and experimentation

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of relevant web front-end development or creative technology experience at a tech-forward, product-driven company
  • Advanced knowledge of modern HTML and CSS
  • Experience writing clear, elegant code in a team environment
  • A zeal for the web as a storytelling medium, demonstrable through a portfolio of design work and frontend code showcasing design systems, engaging microsites, Figma plugins, webGL experiments, CSS art, or anything else—you tell us
  • Experience designing and building public-facing websites that work elegantly across commonly used browsers and devices

Preferred qualifications

  • A good understanding of the formal elements of design, not just limited to the web and including typography, layout, balance, and proportion
  • Proficiency with React, with a focus on interactions, animation, performance, and polish
  • Experience with A/B testing, synthetic monitoring, or accessibility testing
descriptions.job-0nwv6xh:
Who we are

 

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 

About the team

Abuse Control Engineering (ACE) is Stripe’s rapid-response technical defense and control incubator. When urgent abuse vectors emerge, ACE bridges the gap using real attacker telemetry to prototype, test, and deploy software safeguards before vulnerabilities can be exploited at scale. We partner closely with Fraud, Risk and Product Engineering to run rigorous experiments, balancing aggressive risk mitigation against legitimate user conversion. Operating as both a strike team and an incubator, ACE builds automated regression suites in partnership with Abuse Research to permanently block threat recurrence and seamlessly transfers mature controls to long-term product owners across Stripe.

 

What you’ll do

As an Abuse Control Engineer on the Abuse Control Engineering (ACE) team, you will design, prototype, and incubate technical defenses that safeguard Stripe’s financial ecosystem against complex, cross-cutting abuse vectors.

Where emerging threat patterns identify Stripe product weaknesses, ACE steps in to rapidly build and experiment with technical safeguards. Driven by empirical evidence and Stripe’s FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0) framework, you will translate threat intelligence into hard technical control requirements (e.g., API rate-limiting, step-up challenges, parameter validation, pre-debit holds).  You will carefully balance security and product velocity, running experiments to evaluate risk reduction against user conversion impact. Managing controls through a strict incubation lifecycle, you will build automated regression suites to prevent recurrence and partner with native product teams to hand off mature, long-term defenses.  

Responsibilities

  • Rapid Control Prototyping: Design, prototype, and deploy technical controls across API, protocol, and product boundaries to immediately close high-impact abuse vectors.  Evidence-Based Technical Requirements: Translate empirical attacker evidence and FT3 threat research Abuse Research, Fraud and Security into precise technical abuse requirements and control specifications. 
  • Control Co-Design: Collaborate closely with teams across Stripe to co-design resilient, secure controls across payment, onboarding, identity, and Connect surfaces.  
  • Risk Experimentation: Run rigorous experiments and A/B tests to measure risk reduction against legitimate user conversion impact, optimizing controls to minimize friction while neutralizing threats.  
  • Regression Testing: Build comprehensive regression testing suites and automated attack simulations with Abuse Research to ensure mitigated abuse vectors do not recur. 
  • Stakeholder Management: Execute ACE’s incubation model by defining handoff criteria, operational documentation, and target dates to transfer successful controls to product teams.

 

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Security Engineering, Software Engineering, Application Security, or Anti-Abuse Engineering in a high-scale production environment.
  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong software development background with expert proficiency in Python, Go, Java, or similar production languages, alongside expert SQL skills for analyzing system telemetry.
  • Hands-on engineering experience building API-level safeguards, rate-limiting frameworks, authentication/authorization checks, or input validation controls.
  • Demonstrated experience with automated testing frameworks, including writing unit, integration, and regression tests for critical backend software.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of partnering across security, product, and platform teams to drive technical outcomes.

 

Preferred qualifications

  • Proven track record of designing and executing A/B tests, evaluating control efficacy, and balancing security safeguards against user conversion friction.
  • Deep expertise in threat modeling, secure system architecture, and modern application security design principles.
  • Familiarity with established threat frameworks (e.g., FT3, MITRE ATT&CK) and applying adversary kill chain analysis to build resilient defenses.
  • Strong domain knowledge of financial fraud vectors, threat actor TTPs, and attacker infrastructure (e.g., Account Takeover, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).
  • Hands-on experience with large-scale data processing platforms (e.g., Databricks, Trino, PySpark) to monitor and measure control performance across distributed systems.
  • Demonstrated capability in incubating software features, establishing clear operational handoff criteria, and seamlessly transitioning ownership to partner engineering teams.

descriptions.job-0872swl:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure. 

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot is seeking a Data Center Asset Manager to join our Central Operations team. In this role, you will own the end-to-end strategy and process for how physical assets — from critical power and cooling infrastructure to IT and networking equipment — are tracked, assessed, and managed across Riot's data center portfolio. You will build the Asset Management strategy and the operational process that sits under it, own the CMMS platform as the system of record for asset data, and lead site-level asset gap assessments and remediation as they arise across the portfolio. 

You will lead Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and criticality assessments across key asset classes, using the results to define Riot's Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) program strategy — the framework for what preventive and predictive tasks get performed, and at what intervals, before that strategy is operationalized by site teams.

This position is remote/hybrid, with regular travel to Riot's Rockdale site to support site assessments, audits, and coordination with site teams. 

What you'll do

  • Develop and own the Asset Management strategy — the fleet-wide approach to how physical data center assets are tracked, assessed, valued, maintained and managed through their lifecycle. 
  • Develop the Asset Management process that operationalizes the strategy: asset onboarding, tagging and classification standards, transfers, audits, and decommissioning. 
  • Own the data integrity in the CMMS platform as the system of record for asset data — configuration, asset registers, reporting, and data integrity standards; partner with IT/platform teams where the CMMS integrates with DCIM, ServiceNow, or other systems of record. 
  • Lead site-level asset gap assessments and remediation as needed across the portfolio — validating inventories, resolving missing or incomplete asset data, and standing up accurate, audit-ready asset registers. 
  • Identify dominant failure modes, risk, and maintenance-relevant failure data across key asset classes through Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and criticality analysis, partnering with Engineering to resolve identified failure modes into the technical basis for maintenance strategy. 
  • Apply FMEA and criticality outputs to define and continuously refine Riot's Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) program strategy — the basis for PM task selection, intervals, and prioritization across the fleet. 
  • Reconcile client-provided scopes of work and contractual asset coverage expectations against OEM manufacturer operating manuals and suggested maintenance intervals, and incorporate into Riot's maintenance strategy. 
  • Develop the spares strategy — what spares are needed, stocking levels, and lead times — in coordination with the Logistics team, including defining the ownership handoff between asset strategy (what's needed) and Logistics execution (procurement and stocking). 
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting the asset program, including asset standards, classification schemes, and process documentation for audit and operational use. 
  • Collaborate closely with site-based Asset & Maintenance Planners, who execute the Asset Management strategy day-to-day at their sites, to ensure the strategy translates cleanly into site-level execution 
  • Conduct or oversee periodic asset audits and inventory validations to maintain compliance and audit readiness. 
  • Ensure asset records, controls, and documentation meet Finance, Internal Audit, and SOC 2 requirements, maintaining audit-ready evidence for identity, physical access, and asset-related controls in scope. 
  • Monitor asset health, utilization, and status trends across the portfolio to identify risk areas and process gaps, and report findings to Central Operations leadership. 
  • Define the handoff points between the Asset Management strategy and the downstream Maintenance Strategy. 

What you'll have

  • 7+ years of experience in asset management, fixed asset management, or reliability/maintenance programs within data center, industrial, or other critical infrastructure environments 
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered 
  • CMRP (Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional) or familiarity with ISO 55000/55001 asset management standards strongly preferred
  • Ability to travel 50% of the time 
  • Demonstrated experience owning or administering a CMMS platform (e.g., Nuvolo, Maximo, IBM TRIRIGA, or similar)
  • Strong technical writing skills — able to produce clear, audit-ready standards, SOPs, and process documentation 
  • Experience developing asset lifecycle, spares/inventory, or maintenance strategies, ideally across a multi-site portfolio 
  • Experience conducting FMEA or criticality analysis and applying it to design a Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) program 
  • Ability to reconcile conflicting inputs — client contractual requirements vs. OEM manufacturer specifications — into a coherent, defensible strategy 
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills; able to work with Procurement, Logistics, Facilities, Standards & Governance, and site operations teams without direct authority 

Compensation and Benefits 

  • Competitive Salary: $155,000-$170,000 (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant. 
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build. 
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match. 
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans. 
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work. 

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
descriptions.job-1d6n3o5:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX is going all-in on AI-native localisation. The field has long been stuck on one trade-off: you can have translation quality, or you can have scale, but not both. And the real question was never "is this translation accurate?" — it's "can the user actually understand it and get through the flow?"
Web3 is the hardest place to solve this. The vocabulary reinvents itself constantly, with new tech jargon, protocol names and memes appearing every week. It sits next to dense, high-stakes trading terminology, where a single mistranslated word can mislead a user or move money. And every market has its own fast-moving regulations, so the "right" translation is a moving target that must stay compliant across jurisdictions in real time. If you want a localisation problem that is genuinely unsolved — high ambiguity, high stakes, high velocity — this is it.
We're going to break the trade-off with agents. You will own the 0-1 build and launch of two things:
  • A frontier agentic translation system that localises every market (20+ languages) with a human-in-the-loop mechanism.
  • A self-improving agentic QA product that autonomously evaluates translation and end-to-end localisation quality, flags its own failures, and closes the loop.
This is a build-the-frontier role, not a manage-the-vendor role.
 
This role does not require a linguistics or translation background, multilingual ability, or algorithm engineering skills. We're looking for a PM leader who can build a frontier agentic translation and QA system from 0 to 1 — and make the whole organisation share responsibility for localisation quality.

What You’ll Be Doing

You will lead a squad of product managers and developers, and work hand-in-hand with language managers, to ship the translation and QA systems into production. You set the product direction and quality bar; your PMs and engineers build the agents, harness and evals; and the language managers ground the system in what "good" actually means in each market. Your job is to make these three groups operate as one team — and to make localisation quality something the whole organisation owns, not just the language team.
 

Own the agentic translation system

Architect and ship it end to end, from 0 to 1, across all markets and 20+ languages — where models carry the work and humans set the standard and make the final call. Break the cost curve: hold quality flat while coverage scales across languages, content and release velocity, so cost stops growing linearly with the business. Make the system interoperate cleanly with OKX's existing localisation stack and content pipelines, rather than living as an island.

Build the agentic QA and quality automation

Stand up an autonomous QA agent that evaluates translation and localisation quality at scale — catching regressions before release, monitoring in production, and self-verifying every fix, using LLM-as-a-judge and eval harnesses rather than manual review. Evaluate not just accuracy and fluency but cultural fit, bias and safety — especially on regulated and financial content, where a wrong or non-compliant phrasing is a real risk. Make quality measurable: define and drive a hard quality signal — human-acceptance rate, or the edit effort needed to reach shippable quality (e.g. Translation Time-to-Edit) — so quality is a metric the system optimises against, not a subjective call. And protect the funnel: conversion on key user journeys should never be adversely affected by language or localisation issues.

Make it self-improving

Drive a sustained reduction in severe and recurring production issues — every escape becomes a new guardrail, and the system gets smarter with every release.
 

What We Look For In You 

  • PM leader who has taken a frontier agentic product from 0 to 1, beyond translation.
  • Proven ability to ship genuinely novel products at the edge of LLM capabilities—and repeat that success here.
  • Accountable for business outcomes and measured on business metrics, not delivery volume.
  • Deep hands-on experience building large-scale, frontier-LLM agentic systems from 0 to 1.
  • Experience with harness/orchestration layers, multi-agent workflows, and LLM-as-a-judge or automated evaluation pipelines.
  • Has built quality systems, automated evaluations, or release gates that enable confident autonomous-system launches.
  • International product experience serving users across multiple languages and regions.

Nice to Haves

  • Built an agentic system from scratch
  • Shipped agentic / LLM applications in production
  • Finance, payments or another highly regulated industry.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

The Enterprise CSM, Bill Pay & Procurement Specialist, ensures Ramp’s upmarket customers quickly unlock value from our AP Automation and Procurement products. As part of the Customer Activation team, you’ll guide customers through implementation, configure workflows aligned to their internal processes, and help them operationalize Ramp’s tools to drive efficiency and compliance. In this role, you will help shape Ramp’s Enterprise activation motion for Bill Pay & Procurement and influence the strategy that accelerates customer adoption and business impact.

What You’ll Do

Deliver High-Quality Implementations

  • Lead Enterprise customers through the end-to-end onboarding of Ramp Bill Pay and Procurement, ensuring fast, accurate, and complete deployment

  • Educate customers on Ramp’s AP workflows, procurement best practices, approval logic, vendor management, and policy configuration

Drive Customer Adoption & Business Outcomes

  • Prevent delays in implementation by proactively identifying blockers and reinforcing the value of adopting Ramp’s AP & Procurement solutions

  • Understand customers’ current AP, purchasing, and approval processes to identify pain points, recommend improvements, and guide them toward an optimized rollout

About the Job

We are seeking a dynamic and strategic VP of Strategic Partnerships to build and scale a channel-led go-to-market motion. The role will be responsible for expanding market reach and driving partner sourced revenue. You will own the entire partner lifecycle, from sourcing and onboarding to negotiating commercial terms and developing joint go-to-market (GTM) strategies to enable their sales and account teams to resell zerohash’s Trade, Transact, and Tokenization capabilities across their installed customer base.

Candidates must be located within a 1-hour driving radius of one of our main office hubs (Chicago, NYC, UK/Amsterdam for EMEA).

Responsibilities

  • Identify, recruit, and negotiate agreements with strategic at scale channel partners with distribution reach into banks, fintechs, brokerages, payment companies and marketplaces, and build a qualified pipeline of strategic partnership targets.

  • Act as the primary point of contact and digital asset domain expert as you build out the channel ecosystem.
  • Drive partner-sourced revenue by maintaining a healthy opportunity pipeline, tracking joint KPIs, and conducting quarterly business reviews.

  • Structure revenue share, referral, wholesale/reseller, minimum-commitment terms that align incentives across zerohash, the partner, and the partner’s customers.
  • Build partner enablement by developing or repurpose training, certification, playbooks, and sales tools that equip partner sales teams to sell zerohash-powered capabilities.
  • Drive co-marketing with partner marketing teams on joint go-to-market campaigns, content, and launch plans that drive revenue through the channel.
  • Track and report performance, define sell-through metrics and revenue attribution; report on partnership health and ROI to executive leadership.
  • Champion channel strategy internally and act as the connective tissue across Sales, Product, Solution Engineers, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to ensure the partner motion is supported end to end.
  • Position the company as a thought leader in the digital asset and fintech space. Stay abreast of industry trends, regulatory developments, emerging technologies, and competitive positioning.
  • Represent zerohash at industry conferences, forums, and key events to build visibility and credibility in US, EU and international markets.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in partnerships, business development, or channel sales
  • Deep understanding of the digital asset/cryptocurrency and payments ecosystem

  • Direct experience designing partner commercial models
  • Experience building and scaling partner GTM enablement programs
  • Strong executive presence and negotiation skills; able to structure deals credibly with partner C-suite, legal, and finance stakeholders.

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.

  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

What you will be responsible for:

What you'll own

  • Deploy and operate parallel/distributed storage systems: WEKA, VAST Data, Ceph, DDN/Lustre. Design storage architectures optimized for AI workload patterns — checkpoint I/O bursts, sequential dataset reads, KV cache for inference.
  • Implement multi-tenant storage isolation with per-tenant QoS, quotas, and access controls; configure and optimize GPU Direct Storage for direct GPU-to-storage data paths.
  • Deploy and manage storage networking (NFS over RDMA, NVMe-oF, high-speed storage fabrics) and Nvidia CMX for cluster-wide storage orchestration.
  • Diagnose and tune storage performance: IOPS, throughput, latency profiling with fio, IOR, mdtest; own the runbook for common failure modes.
  • Plan storage capacity aligned with GPU cluster growth and customer workload projections; manage firmware, data migration, and DR procedures.


Feed the AIOps substrate

  • Instrument storage telemetry — IO tail latency, checkpoint durations, NVMe SMART, filesystem health, RDMA counters — into the metrics/logs/traces store the platform team runs.
  • Partner with the platform team to define the storage-fault predictor: which signals, which labels (from your incidents), which false-positive tolerances.
  • Convert every novel incident into an automation: SOPs become runbook-as-code, runbook-as-code becomes an agent-executable remediation.

What success looks like in year 1

  • Observability and a baseline predictor for the top 3 storage-fault classes on our fabric.
  • Storage-incident MTTR measurably lower than at hire.
  • The Nvidia GB200-class clusters we build out ship on your storage design.

How you will stand out:

  • 5+ years in enterprise or HPC storage operations, with at least 2 years supporting AI/ML workloads
  • Hands-on deployment and operations experience with at least two of: WEKA, VAST Data, Ceph, DDN/Lustre
  • Strong understanding of AI training I/O patterns: checkpoint frequency, dataset loading, shuffle buffers
  • Experience with high-performance storage networking (NFS over RDMA, NVMe-oF)
  • Knowledge of GPU Direct Storage and RDMA-based data transfer
  • Proficiency in storage performance benchmarking and tuning (fio, IOR, mdtest)
  • Experience implementing multi-tenant storage with isolation and QoS
  • Strong Linux systems knowledge (kernel tuning, filesystem internals, block device management)
  • Instinct for turning ops toil into ML signal — you've either shipped an anomaly detector for storage/IO telemetry or you can articulate the labels and features you'd need to.
  • Runbook-as-code mindset — every SOP you write should be executable by a machine within a quarter

What you will experience working with us:

  • A culture that values authenticity and diversity of thoughts and backgrounds;
  • An inclusive and respectable environment with open workspaces and exciting start-up spirit;
  • Fast-growing company with the chance to network with industrial pioneers and enthusiasts;
  • Ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset industry;
  • Involvement in new projects, developing processes/systems;
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, fast growth, and learning opportunities;
  • Attractive welfare benefits and developmental opportunities such as training and mentoring.

Who You Are

Galaxy is seeking a People Operations Manager, Global Payroll & HRIS to join our People team in a hands-on, execution-focused role supporting our global workforce. This position will initially join on a temporary-to-permanent basis and will play a critical role in two key areas: global payroll operations and the implementation of Workday, with a targeted go-live date of January 1, 2027. Leading up to go-live, this individual will partner closely with People, Payroll, Finance, Technology, external implementation partners, and other key stakeholders to support the successful implementation of Workday. Following implementation, the role will transition toward ongoing ownership and optimization of Workday and global payroll operations, including system administration, data integrity, reporting, process improvement, controls, and the employee experience.

    • Review payroll inputs and outputs to ensure employees are paid accurately, completely, and on time.
    • Perform payroll audits, reconciliations, and variance analyses and proactively investigate and resolve discrepancies.
    • Coordinate employee lifecycle changes impacting payroll, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, benefits deductions, leaves, and other employee changes.
    • Partner with Finance on payroll funding, reconciliations, reporting, and related accounting requirements.

    • Assist with new hire onboarding, employee data changes, transfers, and offboarding processes within Workday and related HR systems.

ComplyAdvantage has an opening for an E-Commerce Support Specialist to join its E-commerce team on a six-month contract. This role owns the end-to-end account provisioning process, ensuring new customers gain immediate access to their environment and that access is promptly removed when accounts churn. It's an opportunity to bring structure to a manual, evolving workflow and help lay the groundwork for full automation.

Why This Role Exists

  • Our E-commerce program currently lacks a fully automated method for managing the environment lifecycle. Currently, creating environments for new customers, providing instant access for trial members, and deactivating environments when customers churn are manual processes.
  • This role exists to bridge the gap between our current manual state and a fully automated future. The Account Provisioning Contractor will own the end-to-end manual provisioning process, ensuring new users get immediate value and that security is maintained by promptly removing access for canceled accounts.

What You Will Do

  • This is an operational role focused on the E-commerce customer journey. You are responsible for the "first-mile" and "last-mile" of the customer experience: getting them into their environment quickly and ensuring access is revoked accurately when they leave.
  • You will be the primary point of contact for provisioning-related support, ensuring that if a customer hits a snag gaining access, you are there to resolve it.

Primary Responsibilities

  1. Environment Provisioning & Deactivation
    • Manually create and configure environments for new E-commerce trial members and paying customers to ensure immediate access.
    • Monitor customer churn and trial cancellations to immediately deactivate environments, preventing unauthorized access.
    • Ensure the trial experience is seamless, allowing new members to access their environments without delay.
  2. Provisioning Support & Troubleshooting
    • Act as the functional expert for account access issues, responding to customer inquiries when they cannot reach their environments.
    • Investigate and resolve technical blockers in the provisioning flow using internal tools.
    • Coordinate with engineering and support teams to escalate and resolve systemic access bugs.
  3. Process Documentation & AI Integration
    • Document the manual "tribal knowledge" required for provisioning to create repeatable playbooks.
    • Use AI tooling to draft communications for customers regarding their account status and access instructions.
    • Identify repetitive tasks within the provisioning lifecycle that are candidates for future automation.
  4. Identify potential competitors & partners
    • Flag potential competitors and partners requesting trial access, either denying access or routing the request to the appropriate internal team.

Tooling Environment

This is an ever-evolving position; you will need to be comfortable learning and switching between various platforms as the product matures.

  • Mesh: Used for core account provisioning and environment management capabilities.
  • Pylon: For managing support tickets and access-related inquiries.
  • Gainsight: To track customer health, churn signals, and trial status.
  • AI Layer (Gemini/Claude): Used to automate drafting and analyze provisioning data.

What Success Looks Like

At 7 Days: 

    • Full proficiency in Mesh and its environment-handling capabilities is demonstrated.
    • Successfully managing all incoming provisioning and deactivation requests with zero backlog.
    • Handling all support inquiries related to account access independently.

At 15 Days: 

    • Measurable reduction in the time between a trial sign-up and environment availability.

At 30 Days: 

    • Provisioning workflows are consistently meeting internal speed benchmarks.
    • Contribution of data and process mapping has directly informed the requirements for the automated provisioning engine.

Requirements

  • Experience: Technical support or operations background with an understanding of user lifecycle management.
  • Technical Aptitude: Comfort working across multiple SaaS applications and an instinct for how tools should integrate.
  • Communication: Strong written English for professional customer-facing support and documentation.
  • Mindset: Highly organized and process-oriented; you enjoy building systems out of manual chaos.

The base salary range for this role is $30,000-$35,000 plus equity, and benefits. The actual pay may vary based on factors such as location, experience, and skills.

About us

Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime. 

By harnessing AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem, we help customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and enduring regulatory trust.

More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our end-to-end platform and the world’s most comprehensive financial crime risk intelligence. With full-stack agentic automation, we help organizations automate up to 95% of KYC, AML, and sanctions reviews, cut onboarding times by 50%, reduce false positives by 70%, and handle 7x more work with the same staff.

ComplyAdvantage is headquartered in London and has global hubs in New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and Cluj-Napoca. It is backed by Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan, Goldman Sachs, and Andreessen Horowitz. descriptions.job-039dx3p:
VP of Communications

 

Mission

LENS’s mission is to end traffic accidents. LENS prevents accidents and saves lives by detecting hazards to prevent accidents before they happen.

 

Platform & Product

LENS Detect scans CCTV feeds on highways to identify hazards, in real-time, before they become accidents. Public Safety agencies, alongside Departments of Transportation, receive alerts on the LENS Detect dashboard about Disabled Vehicles, Stalled Big Rigs, and Pedestrians on Freeway. A dispatcher reviews and validates the detection, and then dispatches an officer to the scene to assist the person in need — resulting in either preventing an accident or saving a life.

CBS LA recently did a three minute TV feature that succinctly captures what LENS is doing with Public Safety Agencies in one of the largest traffic capitals in the world:

CHP LA Communications Center using AI to prevent accidents before they happen

 

Role & Responsibilities

As the VP of Communications, you seek transformational change. You do not accept the status quo that accidents are an accepted inevitability, or that they just happen. Instead, you believe when the root cause of an accident can be known in advance, the accident can and should be prevented. You work with fellow Preventers that share this core belief, using LENS to prevent accidents and save lives.

 

Your responsibilities are:

  • Define and execute the communications strategy that shapes how the world understands LENS: who we are, what we do, and why it matters. Communications owns the narrative layer that precedes every agency relationship, investor conversation, and policy engagement.

  • Owning the LENS narrative across media, government, and the public. Your audiences are journalists, policymakers, government officials, and the broader public safety community. You ensure every message landing in those channels is clear, credible, and reinforcing the mission, working with Marketing and Customer teams to convert that credibility into mission impact.

  • Building and leading earned media strategy, developing relationships with journalists, producers, and outlets covering AI, public safety, transportation, and technology. You turn LENS's real-world impact into stories that build institutional trust and public awareness at scale.

  • Preparing and coaching leadership for public appearances, including press interviews, congressional testimony, conference keynotes, and policy forums, so every appearance advances LENS's credibility with the audiences that shape the environment we operate in.

  • Building and maintaining a rapid response capability, ensuring LENS can comment quickly and credibly on breaking news in AI, public safety, and traffic incidents in a way that inserts the mission into the conversations that are already happening.

 

Mindset, Principles, and Skills & Experience

 

Your mindset is grounded in:

  • The mission is the most powerful story. Every accident prevented and every life saved deserves to be celebrated. You find, shape, and tell those stories with the weight they deserve, in a way that earns institutional trust, reaches policymakers and the public, and creates the conditions in which LENS can serve more agencies.

  • Simultaneously setting foundation, while remaining curious and open. You build the communications infrastructure LENS needs today - messaging frameworks, media relationships, crisis protocols - while staying open to new formats, channels, and approaches that expand the mission's reach.

  • Adaptability drives evolution. The communications landscape changes constantly. You don't wait for a playbook - you write it, and refine it as you learn what lands.

 

Principles you share with us are:

  • We focus to supercharge our creative impact. You concentrate communications energy on the channels, stories, and moments that will move the needle most - not every opportunity equally, but the ones that reach the most people and advance the mission fastest.

  • Begin with the end in mind. Before drafting a message or pitching a story, you identify the outcome you want - a new agency relationship opened, public trust built, a policy door unlocked - and work backwards to the communications strategy that gets there.

  • Invest the most time where it makes the most progress. You evaluate every communications initiative by the 80/20 rule, directing energy toward the stories, relationships, and moments that create the most mission impact.

 

The Skills & Experience you have are:

  • Building and leading communications functions at mission-driven technology companies, government-facing organizations, or in a senior agency role supporting high-profile clients.

  • Earned media expertise - a track record of placing stories in top-tier national outlets and building durable relationships with journalists covering technology, public safety, and policy.

  • Delivering communications outcomes that build trust with government agency partners - where credibility, consistency, and careful message management are non-negotiable.

  • Executive communications and media coaching - experience preparing CEOs and senior leaders for press, public appearances, and high-stakes stakeholder engagements.

  • Crisis communications - proven ability to manage sensitive situations with speed, clarity, and sound judgment under pressure.

  • Being a senior management member, working alongside other senior operators to advance a meaningful, mission-driven cause.

 

The time to accept traffic accidents is ending, and the time to prevent them has begun. This belief is becoming more of an inevitable reality every day. The number of agencies LENS serves keeps growing - and the world needs to know why. If you want to shape the narrative of a company preventing accidents and saving lives, and use the power of communication to accelerate that mission, this role is for you.

LENS is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Note: This is an individual contributor role.

About the role

We are looking for a senior marketer to drive the growth and adoption of our payments products across global markets.

The role combines regional and global growth, product marketing, and product amplification. You will contribute directly to growth of the Payment Business Unit products, lead GTM for new products and features across Bybit Card, Bybit Pay, money transfers and localized payment solutions, and make our existing products easier for customers to discover, understand and use.

You will work closely with Product, Operations, regional teams and marketing specialists, taking ownership of key initiatives and driving them forward through the right mix of direct execution and cross-functional collaboration.

What you will own

1. Regional & Global Growth

  • Own regional or global growth workstreams contributing to Payment Business Unit OKRs, across acquisition, activation, usage and retention.

  • Develop and optimize growth mechanisms such as rewards, cashback, referrals, lifecycle programs and promotional propositions, often in partnership with Product and Operations.

  • Adapt our growth approach to local customer behaviors, payment habits and market context, working closely with regional teams where relevant.

  • Drive continuous growth of existing products through scalable initiatives beyond one-off campaigns.

2. Product GTM

  • Lead GTM for new payment products, features and market expansions, from positioning and target audience to channel strategy and execution.

  • Translate complex payment capabilities into clear customer propositions, messaging and use cases.

  • Coordinate cross-functional launch execution and define the right success metrics.

  • Use post-launch performance and customer feedback to improve adoption and inform future GTM decisions.

3. Product Amplification & Customer Understanding

  • Make our payment products and use cases easier to discover, understand and adopt across owned, earned and paid channels.

  • Turn product capabilities, customer insights and market context into relevant marketing narratives and initiatives.

  • Orchestrate CRM, social, PR, paid media, partnerships, creators and regional teams, while executing directly when required.

  • Contribute over time to building the visibility, positioning and thought leadership of Bybit Payments.

What success looks like

  • Marketing initiatives make a measurable contribution to regional and global business growth.

  • New products and features launch with strong customer propositions and effective GTM execution.

  • Existing products continue to gain adoption, engagement and visibility after launch.

  • Customers increasingly understand the value and use cases of our Payments products.

  • Marketing initiatives are grounded in strong product understanding, customer needs and business priorities.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of experience across Product Marketing, Growth, GTM or related roles.

  • Strong experience in fintech, payments, banking, crypto or another complex consumer product environment.

  • Strong product and customer judgment, with the ability to translate product capabilities and user needs into effective marketing strategies.

  • Experience driving acquisition, activation, engagement and retention.

  • Experience developing growth mechanisms such as rewards, referrals, lifecycle programs or incentives.

  • Strong analytical judgment, with the ability to prioritize based on business impact.

  • Ability to simplify complex financial products into compelling and accessible customer propositions.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to operate autonomously across multiple markets and workstreams.

  • Clear and concise communication style.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
descriptions.job-0m7iy8l:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

What you’ll do

As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous engineers in the industry and learn how to ship high-quality work at scale. By contributing to Stripe’s codebase you’ll work across domains that give you insight into how the global economy works. Recent intern projects include expanding Stripe’s Payments Foundation Model capabilities to improve generalized anomaly detection, building more approachable fraud controls, creating safer payouts, and developing user-facing solutions that prevent costly pricing mistakes and make merchant checkout setup easier.

Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. 

Responsibilities

  • Operate as a real member of the team you join; engage in team discussions, decisions, and the technical design process.
  • Write software that will be used in production, and has meaningful impact to Stripe’s business and users.
  • Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews or design discussions
  • Collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to proactively seek and incorporate feedback.
  • Learn quickly by asking great questions, working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, communicating the status of your work clearly, and building with the latest AI tooling.

Who you are

  • Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
  • Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 
  • Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

  • A strong fundamental understanding of computer science through pursuit of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, math, or a related discipline. 
  • Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Ruby, Java, Javascript, Go, and Scala. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.
  • Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts. 
  • Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

Preferred qualifications

  • At least 1 year of university education, or equivalent work experience.
  • One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. 
  • Experience writing high quality pull requests, with good test coverage, and working knowledge to complete projects with minimal defects.
  • Familiarity with navigating and managing your work in new code bases, with multiple languages.
  • Clear written communication skills, with the ability to write clearly to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.

CoinDesk is the most trusted media, events, indices and data company for the global crypto economy. Since 2013, CoinDesk Media has led the story of the future of money and investing, illuminating the transformation in society and culture that comes with it. Our award-winning team of journalists delivers news and unparalleled insights that bring transparency, comprehension and context. CoinDesk Events gathers the global crypto, blockchain and Web3 communities at annual events such as Consensus, the world’s largest and longest-running crypto festival. CoinDesk Indices offers expertise in digital asset indices, data and research to educate and empower investors. For more information on CoinDesk media and events, please visit http://coindesk.com [coindesk.com] and for breaking headlines, data and indices visit http://coindeskmarkets.com [coindeskmarkets.com]

In November 2023, CoinDesk was acquired by the Bullish group, owner of Bullish, a regulated, digital assets exchange. For more information on Bullish, please visit https://bullish.com . CoinDesk operates as an independent subsidiary with an editorial committee to protect journalistic independence.

Reports to:

Director - PMO, Change & Delivery

About the Role

Bullish is redefining the capital markets infrastructure by bridging traditional equity systems with blockchain-based tokenization. To drive this vision forward, we are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead the post-merger integration (PMI) of an established, blue-chip financial services leader into our nimble, hyper-scalable organization. You will own the day-to-day execution of this integration, transforming our post-merger strategy into a cohesive, high-performing model while operating at the strategic altitude required to align C-suite executives and global leaders across both businesses and our broader ecosystem.

This is a highly unique and impactful opportunity. The work you do here will directly impact the future state of our combined business, and position Bullish as an enduring leader in the next chapter of capital markets infrastructure. If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

This position will be required to work onsite at our NYC office a minimum of 4 days per week. 

Key Responsibilities

Business Integration & Operational Modernization:

  • Cross-Functional Execution: Lead and execute the end-to-end integration of core functional lines: People & Organization, Technology, Finance & Accounting, Legal & Compliance, Cost Synergies, and Communications & Branding.

  • Operations Modernization: Identify manual operations and redundant backend processes across both businesses and our broader  ecosystem; partner with Executive Leadership to drive automation, efficiency, and cross-platform synergies.

  • Functional Architecture Alignment: Maintain high-level oversight of enterprise system integrations (HRIS, ERP, Cloud, SaaS). Ensure operational workflows are correctly structured around legal entities, cost centers, lines of business, and governance frameworks to safeguard future-state scalability.

Workforce Planning & Resource Optimization:

  • Plan Execution: Translate pre-established capacity analysis into actionable, long-term resource allocation strategies across Technology, Operations, and Compliance.

  • Data-Driven Modeling: Partner with Finance, HR, and Operations to build and refine dynamic human capital, budget, and infrastructure utilization models.

  • Pipeline Readiness: Align staffing models with Executive Leaders to ensure Product, Engineering, Operations, and Regulatory teams are equipped to handle incoming tokenization and digital asset pipelines.

  • Financial Alignment: Continuously monitor integration milestones against cost-synergy targets and revenue milestones.

Stakeholder Alignment & Change Leadership

  • Executive Presence: Manage geographically distributed, highly matrixed technical and non-technical stakeholders—from operational managers to C-Suite executives.

  • Tailored Communication: Navigate varying levels of organizational buy-in by clearly articulating the "why" behind strategic shifts, fostering trust, and driving consensus across distinct corporate cultures.

  • Autonomous Problem Solving: Lead with absolute ownership. Unblock operational bottlenecks independently while exercising sound judgment on when to escalate key risks to executive sponsors.

Risk, Governance & Issue Management

  • Risk Register Ownership: Maintain a living risk register tracking issues, decisions, and escalations, reporting status regularly to the executive sponsor.

  • Interdependency Management: Map cross-workstream dependencies to prevent sequencing failures and resolve blockers early.

  • Escalation Protocols: Enforce clear escalation frameworks, solving problems autonomously and escalating key risks appropriately.

  • Governance Cadence: Run steering committee meetings, workstream syncs, and executive reporting to ensure full visibility into progress, risks, and decisions.

Qualifications & Expertise:

  • Experience: 10+ years in Program Management or Management Consulting, leading complex Post-Merger Integrations (PMI), carve-outs, or enterprise-wide operational transformations.

  • Domain Knowledge: Core understanding of capital markets infrastructure, corporate enterprise workflows, and a strong interest in digital assets, tokenized securities, and stablecoins.

  • Analytical Capability: Proven track record of converting capacity metrics, headcount data, and operational analytics into sustainable resource allocation plans.

  • Soft Skills & Maturity: High emotional intelligence, professional maturity, and the ability to balance empathy with decisive accountability during periods of enterprise change.

  • Education & Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field. PMP, Agile/Scrum, or M&A-specific certifications are preferred.

Preferred Experience:

  • Leading large-scale operational modernizations or business integrations requiring enterprise-wide process adoption.

  • Directing change management programs aligned with core financial systems or regulatory frameworks.

Bullish US LLC & CoinDesk Inc. are committed to offering competitive compensation and benefits. The anticipated base salary for this position is $240,000 - $275,000 + discretionary annual target bonus + performance incentives/benefits. Offered salary will be reflective of job related knowledge, skills and commensurate experience.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

In an effort to attract, retain, develop and promote the most qualified individuals, CoinDesk is committed to treating all applicants and employees in a nondiscriminatory manner with respect to the terms and conditions of employment, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status/service, physical or mental disability, or any other classification protected by applicable law. This mandate governs all aspects of employment, including recruitment, selection, promotion, training, education, social and recreation programs, compensation, discipline, termination and access to benefits.

ACCOMMODATION
